sharedGeometry.appliesTo: round circle with optional square lower/upper tabs; palette variants reuse the same geometry
7 C5-A city backings; same city emblem, only the outside backing differs
76 alpha/beta circles; two existing font-outline glyphs, one common circle
14 instances; one flared strip plus existing digit/star paths
1 Knossos nameplate; reuse city emblem and a separate clean banner/text outline
11 four-digit hidden labels / 44 source digit components; reuse existing font, bounds, colours and rotation from tools/map-hidden-number-regions.json and complete-map-hidden-numbers.py

excludedFromNewEmblemCount.cornerAndRouteAssets: River, locks, helmet and C3 category emblems belong to the link/corner inventory and are not counted twice.
excludedFromNewEmblemCount.hiddenNumbers: 17 large + 27 small components are 44 real hidden-number digits in 11 complete labels, preserved and classified as reusable existing text.
excludedFromNewEmblemCount.speckles: Only 2 separate antialias speckles (1px and 3px), visually and independently audited, are nonsemantic noise.

routeCategoryTrials.status: authored geometry trials; not yet approved or installed

coverageLimits: Minimum 9 assumes retaining every printed emblem silhouette, including both wheel variants. It counts emblem drawings, not palette changes or repeated placements.
A full vector version still requires authoring and visually approving those missing silhouettes; inventory coverage does not prove redraw fidelity.
The 14 old bitmap-derived contour glyphs are recognition/reference material and are not accepted as clean native final components.
